meta._what_this_file_is: THE CROSSWALK FOR 433-B — one row per engine input key, carrying the FACT each cell holds and the type it is stored as. It carries NO hs_name: adapters/hubspot/derive-names-433b.mjs turns (category, scope, fact) into a name and is the only place a name exists. This file replaced the DECLARED EMPTY crosswalk authored at prompt 46 commit 2, whose zero was honest at the time — the map bound nothing then and binds every one of the form's 447 widgets now.
meta._why_the_file_exists_at_all_rather_than_: adapters/hubspot/assert-intake-keys.mjs builds a CROSS-FORM universe: which columns some form prints and which some form consumes. It reads a crosswalk per mapped form, and on the first run after 433-B's map landed it refused with UNIVERSE GAP — 'a narrowed universe is not a smaller answer to the same question; it is an answer to a different one.' That refusal is correct and this file is the answer to it, not a way around it. A crosswalk that cannot be READ and one that reads ZERO must not report the same thing, and until this file existed they did.
meta._what_this_file_does_NOT_do: It classifies nothing. Crosswalk classification for 433-B — which of this form's facts are the same question as an existing property, which are the same question about a different subject, and which are new — is a separate piece of work and is not begun here. When it is, the decision is governed by the SUBJECT verdict already recorded in adapters/pdf/maps/_subjects.cross-form.json (COINCIDES with 433-B(OIC), MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE with 433-A, 433-F and 433-A(OIC)) and never by the eleven leaf names this form shares with 433-A and 433-F, which adapters/pdf/maps/433b.lineage.json shows are inert.
meta._the_zero_is_derived_not_asserted: `bindings` is empty because `map` in adapters/pdf/maps/433b.map.json is empty. Both are 0 in the same commit and either becoming non-zero without the other is a disagreement the next run will report.
meta._the_reuse_rows_are_the_finding: NINE ROWS CARRY `reuse_of`, AND THEY ARE THE FIRST IN THIS SERIES. Every form before 433-B came out 100% form-specific because its subject was new; 433-B's subject COINCIDES with 433-B(OIC)'s, so [R-06]'s prefix half applies for the first time and nine facts bind properties the irs433boi_ prefix records 433-B(OIC) as having created. The other 107 rows need a new name. The split is derived from the classification, not typed here.
meta._why_the_counts_block_is_absent: meta.counts IS NOT WRITTEN BY THIS FILE. validate-crosswalk.mjs derives every one of the six figures from the rows and compares; a hand-kept block beside the rows is the shape [R-07] forbids. Its six "says undefined, rows say N" lines are the declaration doing its job, not a gap.
